importantNote: All modern interface upgrades, double-deck floating capsule navigation, YouTube Music style categorized settings, and audio stability patches are fully active in v1.2.0.

items: Redesigned bottom navigation into a sleek glassmorphic capsule dock.
Instant access to Home and Library inside the primary glass capsule.
Independent floating circular Search button with smooth tactile animation.

Android Home Screen Widget integration guide & background audio battery saver recommendations.
